pattern.explanation: The learner divides by 1000 every time, even when converting to a smaller unit that needs multiplying. This produces the answers in problems 1, 2, 4, and 6 exactly. Problems 3 and 5 are right only because those small-to-large conversions do need division by 1000.
pattern.pattern: divides by 1000 for all metric conversions
pattern.practice_focus: converting larger units to smaller units by multiplying by 1000

summary: The learner got 2 of 6 right on Metric Conversions. The work shows one habit: dividing by 1000 each time, even when the change needs multiplying to a smaller unit. That matches the wrong answers in 1, 2, 4, and 6. When doing the practice together, ask first if the new unit is bigger or smaller, then choose multiply or divide. The 5 practice problems target exactly that choice.
